name: rotation-slider
title: Rotation Slider
description: Scroll-pinned horizontal slider with 3D card rotation, vertical drift, and SplitText caption reveals.

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: perspective is flattened, the main scroll tracking loses its smoothing lag, and card rotation is cut to 15% strength

props.name: rotationAmount
props.description: Multiplier on the built-in per-breakpoint rotateY entrance/exit strength as cards scroll by.

props.name: verticalDrift
props.description: Multiplier on the built-in per-breakpoint vertical offset each card travels while scrolling past.

props.name: scrollSmoothing
props.description: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub value on the main horizontal track - higher lags/smooths more, lower tracks scroll 1:1.

props.name: perspective
props.description: 3D perspective distance, in pixels, applied to the sticky track - lower values look deeper/more distorted.

props.name: showCaptions
props.description: Shows the text caption overlay on each card.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Color of the card caption text.
